en.text:
Hitting a target with #d Pellets in the spread increases the damage of your next Melee attack within 3 seconds.

Melee Damage increase by weapon type:
• Shotgun: 150% additional base melee damage
• Hand Cannon: <pve 75% /> <pvp [100?%] /> additional base melee damage

Stowing the weapon removes the buff.

The buff does not stack with the passive Melee Damage increase against <stasis/>Frozen non-Boss targets. The higher buff of the two takes precedence.
